title: Solenoid valve
object: 2/2-way normally closed pilot-operated solenoid valve, G1/2, in axial section
idea: A small signal controlling a big flow: servo amplification through a pilot
summary: A 10 W coil lifts an 11 mm plunger only 3.2 mm, and that opens a 1.6 mm pilot. The pilot drains the chamber above the diaphragm faster than the 0.8 mm bleed refills it, so water pressure lifts the diaphragm after the plunger and 35 L/min flows. Switched off, the bleed lets the diaphragm down slowly enough (0.72 s) that the surge in the pipe stays below 1 bar.
usedFor: Industrial automation and fluid-power training: pilot operation, MOPD, minimum differential pressure, water hammer
Product documentation for solenoid and diaphragm valves
Explaining amplification, or a feature flag as a small pilot signal that switches a large flow
